verdict.rationale: The UK IPO offers digital services (online filing, trade mark search, renewals), so an official CLI is a fair question for this kind of service. However, the evidence pack documents only web forms, online search, email and post channels, with no command-line tool. The probe shows the trade-mark search host blocks agents at robots.txt, which offers no CLI support either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
